name: Digital Downloads
description: Sell or give away downloadable products (files hosted in the media library). Delivery is a token-gated reveal: buyers get an expiring, limited-use download link by email or on screen. Free products deliver instantly with an email; paid orders stay pending until the admin marks them paid (the link is then auto-emailed).
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read products and orders (download tokens, usage counters) from the plugin's own tables.
Create the plugin's tables and write products, orders, sales/download counters and token usage.
Read the plugin's configuration option (currency symbol, manual-payment instructions, link expiry) and the site URL for building download links.
Public routes for the product grid, order creation and token-gated download; admin routes for products/orders/config management.
Add the 'Descargas Digitales' entry to the admin sidebar.
Email buyers their download link (or order-received notice) and notify the admin about new pending orders.
